independentLayoutSource.layout: The pinned reader groups AcVerticalConstraint with parallel/horizontal constraints. autodeskClass.meaning: AcVerticalConstraint derives from AcParallelConstraint and represents a vertical constraint on one constrained line in its owning AcDbAssoc2dConstraintGroup.
